source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** unit of yours that is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units.
parts.effect:
These apply to the unit for the rest of the phase:

- for picking targets for ranged weapons and resolving their attacks, enemy units do not count as in Engagement Range of the unit
- whenever an enemy model whose unit is in Engagement Range of the unit gets **destroyed**, roll a D6; on a 5+, the unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) once the attacking unit's attacks are all done

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase).

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** unit of yours that is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units.

**Effect:** These apply to the unit for the rest of the phase:

- for picking targets for ranged weapons and resolving their attacks, enemy units do not count as in Engagement Range of the unit
- whenever an enemy model whose unit is in Engagement Range of the unit gets **destroyed**, roll a D6; on a 5+, the unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) once the attacking unit's attacks are all done

recoil.trigger: each enemy model destroyed while its unit is within the selected unit’s Engagement Range
recoil.apply: after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks
